map.阿尔茨海默病评定量表-认知部分(ADAS-Cog)，评估认知功能损害程度，总分0: Alzheimer's Disease Assessment Scale-Cognitive subscale (ADAS-Cog), assesses cognitive impairment severity; total score 0-70, higher = worse
map.ADAS-Cog 总分 = 各认知条目得分之和；≤4 正常/极轻、≤9 轻度、≤: ADAS-Cog total = sum of cognitive item scores; ≤4 normal/very mild, ≤9 mild, ≤18 mild-moderate, ≤30 moderate, ≤50 moderate-severe, >50 severe (higher score = worse cognition).
map.1. 单词回忆（0-10分，不能回忆的单词数）: 1. Word recall (0-10, number of words not recalled)
map.3. 命令（0-5分，执行错误的命令数）: 3. Commands (0-5, number of commands executed wrongly)
map.7. 单词辨认（0-12分，不能辨认的单词数）: 7. Word recognition (0-12, number of words not recognized)
map.ADAS-Cog是阿尔茨海默病药物临床试验的金标准量表，评分下降4分(MCID): ADAS-Cog is the gold-standard scale for Alzheimer's drug trials; a 4-point (MCID) decrease is considered clinically meaningful improvement. Mild-moderate AD usually scores 16-35. Used to assess efficacy of anti-dementia drugs (cholinesterase inhibitors, memantine). Note: the scale requires a trained rater; this tool is for auxiliary reference only.
map.阿尔茨海默病认知损害的纵向评估。: Longitudinal assessment of Alzheimer's cognitive impairment.
map.药物临床试验主要终点。: Primary endpoint of drug clinical trials.
map.记忆、语言、执行多域评分。: Multi-domain scoring of memory, language, executive function.
map.12 项（单词回忆、命名、指令、定向等）得分合计 25 分（满分约 70，分数越: 12 items (word recall, naming, commands, orientation, etc.) sum to 25 (max ~70, higher = worse cognition), indicating moderate-severe impairment.
map.合计 12 分：以情景记忆下降为主，建议随访与干预。: Total 12 points: predominantly episodic memory decline, recommend follow-up and intervention.
map.总分越高认知越差，常用于前后对比观察下降速率。: Higher total = worse cognition; often used for before-after comparison of decline rate.
map.ADAS-Cog 对轻度变化更敏感，多用于痴呆药物试验。: ADAS-Cog is more sensitive to mild change, mostly used in dementia drug trials.
